description: Fast mode answers a quick question instead of writing a command.

fastStream.text: It lists the processes with a network socket on port **3000**: the command, its PID, the user, and whether it is listening (`LISTEN`) or connected. Add `-t` to print only PIDs, e.g. `kill $(lsof -t -i :3000)`.
